review_scope: Independent exact rendered-body source review only. No imports, tests, B/network action, worker submission, model-state/array/data payload reads, or execution of the body/checker.

blockers.title: Approved Path compatibility environment is checked by the parent but not explicitly passed to the support unit
evidence: REMOTE_SUBMISSION.py checks this exact variable in its own preflight at lines 1100-1102, then creates systemd-run argv at lines 1312-1338.
That argv explicitly passes CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and four thread limits, but does not include --setenv=FG19_APPROVED_PATH_COMPAT_EXCEPTION=pathlib._local.PosixPath:exact-dictionary-path-only.

The AllThree checker calls control_v3._require_path_compatibility_exception() during verify_terminal before checkpoint decoding. That helper reads os.environ and raises unless the exact variable/value is present.
The parent-process preflight does not bind or prove the per-user systemd manager environment. No frozen guarantee establishes that this exact variable will be present in the transient support unit.
blockers.impact: The one-shot support worker may reach the checker without the required exact-path exception and abort before the approved weights_only decoder. This makes the actual verifier execution environment unbound and can consume the single attempt after output staging.
blockers.required_correction: Explicitly add the exact --setenv=FG19_APPROVED_PATH_COMPAT_EXCEPTION=pathlib._local.PosixPath:exact-dictionary-path-only argument to the frozen systemd-run argv, rerender/rebind the body, and submit a new exact frozen body for independent review. Do not rely on user-manager inheritance.

favorable_findings: The rendered body is pinned exactly and the independent root payload receipt reports 15 payloads, all 15 exact-base64 byte joins, seven private code files, exact 14-key typed-native evidence, and strict integer 0/1/0 fields.

The body repeats typed/raw native identity checks for the run, unit, invocation, active/exited state, strict integer exit fields, positive raw-byte count, raw SHA/path, raw systemd properties, timezone-qualified ordered timestamps, and current exact-unit exited state; it does not use a prior stop as a prerequisite.

Original AllThree admission/launch/launch-acceptance bytes and SHA pins are joined, including original accepted fit invocation and recipe totals; the body requires all 14 exact predecessor receipt pins and profile metadata read-only.

The body bounds a fresh 167-file source-manifest hash/inventory check, canonical split, registered-data and run/cache/parent/dictionary stat-only checks before output mutation; it does not hash or load model, cache-array, or dictionary payloads in those checks.

The body gates a fresh empty campaign cgroup, fixed aggregate memory/CPU/swap envelope, physical ext4 scratch headroom, selected GPU UUID and process ownership before creating its fresh output directory.

The body stages seven private code files and verifies their stable pre-import hashes/origins/closure with isolated -E -B -I execution; its generated runner passes 13 Path objects in the frozen checker API order.

The exact support unit is one 50-percent CPU, 1.4 GB MemoryHigh, 1.5 GB MemoryMax, zero-swap, 600-second attempt with CUDA hidden and BLAS/OpenMP thread limits set to one; timeout, failed submission, and unknown outcomes are durably recorded without retry.
No body self-read is present in the reviewed operational source. No import, test, B action, worker body execution, or model/array/data payload read was performed for this review.
review_limitations: This is a static source review of exact frozen local bytes. Root_PAYLOAD_CHECK is a separate root-authored static byte-binding receipt; this review did not decode or read embedded model, array, or dataset payload contents.
The body has one concrete environment-propagation blocker, so this review does not authorize B admission or execution.
